businesses.business: calibration services and test instrument distribution

offering_description.value: Provides accredited calibration, repair and compliance services for test and measurement instruments to regulated industries such as life sciences, aerospace and industrial manufacturing. Also distributes test and measurement instruments from third-party manufacturers to industrial customers. Services are delivered at its calibration labs, on customer sites and through pickup and delivery.

primary_products.value: test and measurement instruments (resold); calibration equipment; handheld electrical and temperature instruments

primary_services.value: instrument calibration; instrument repair; on-site calibration; calibration management and compliance; asset and inventory management

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, aerospace, defense and industrial manufacturing companies; B2G: government and defense-related agencies and contractors

end_markets.value: life sciences; aerospace and defense; industrial manufacturing; energy and utilities; chemical and food processing

revenue_model.value: service fees: calibration, repair and on-site instrument services, often under recurring contracts; product sales: resold test and measurement instruments and equipment

value_chain_position.value: service provider: calibrates and repairs customers' instruments in labs and on site; distributor: buys instruments from manufacturers and resells to industrial and regulated customers

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and Puerto Rico, with some international customers

specialization.value: related lines: calibration services and test instrument distribution sharing the same customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: field sales team and account managers selling services and instruments; online: e-commerce website and catalog for instrument sales and service requests; own locations: network of calibration laboratories across North America

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Accreditation to ISO/IEC 17025 and customer compliance with FDA GMP and aerospace quality standards
